# Converted Fanatic of Xenagos

The `.txt` and `.provenance.json` of Fanatic of Xenagos (a Tribute card: its keyword line and its
"if tribute wasn't paid" trigger line declare `keyword 1` and a `built` trigger key of it), copied
unchanged from the whole-corpus conversion the review's scratch tree `a25-after` holds. Kept apart
from `gen3-sidecars/` because `make_fixture_records.py` empties that directory and writes only the
sidecars its records name. Read by `tests/unit/effects/infrastructure/test_sidecar_join_contract.py`.
